claims.value: Gabriela Mistral — Chilean poet and educator

scope.description: Named historical Chilean framework and expressly documented institutional or cultural association; no modern-border or nationality inference.

evidence.locator: Cronología 1935 lifetime consular appointment (lines 754–757), subsequent Chile consular posts 1939/1940/1941/1946/1948/1953, death 1957 (lines 926–932); Presentación Chilean literary association and 1914 poetry; 1934 entry (lines 748–752)
evidence.note: Lifetime Chilean consular designation explicitly established by a Congress law on 24 September 1935; expiry at documented death, not an invented end year. Subsequent Chilean consular posts corroborate continued association. Literary contributions named predate the interval.

qualifications: Interval describes expressly lifetime institutional association from Congress law to death; it does not assert daily active cultural production or continuous residence in Chile. Contributions named predate earliest validity. Tala and Nobel are separate dated events. Independent review must confirm lifetime designation is sufficient cultural association.
